messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Instead, I was relieved... at peace you could even say, as I knew in my heart that this is what my dad really wanted all along.

output.original_text: Instead, I was relieved... at peace you could even say, as I knew in my heart that this is what my dad really wanted all along.
output.joy: Instead, I was so relieved... at peace you could even say, with a joyful heart knowing this is exactly what my dad truly wanted all along.
output.sadness: Instead, I was relieved... yet sad, in a way, as I knew deep down that this is what my dad always wished for.
output.fear: Instead, I was relieved... but a nagging fear lingered as I knew in my heart this is what my dad really wanted all along.
output.anger: Instead, I was relieved... but it infuriates me to realize this is what my dad wanted all along, and I wish things had been different.
output.surprise: Instead, I was relieved... surprised even, as I realized in my heart that this is what my dad really wanted all along.
output.disgust: Instead, I was relieved... though I felt disgusted that it took me this long to understand what my dad really wanted all along.
